h: Court reportedly issues fresh order to Nasir El-Rufai in the DSS phone-interception case
p: A court has reportedly issued an order to former Kaduna governor Nasir El-Rufai in the case brought against him by the DSS, which centres on remarks he made in a television interview about intercepted calls. The matter was listed for a ruling on his no-case submission.
more: He was granted N100 million bail in May.
His lawyers argue the prosecution has not shown enough evidence for him to defend himself.
